parts.note_add: Atkins Rotary sells 1668-39-040D new (in stock, 2026-09) but calls it the LEFT mount, while the factory catalogue lists it as RUBBER (R); check which side it sits on before ordering. Atkins lists it as replacing 0866-39-040B, 1540-39-040, 1668-39-040C and 2329-39-040A.
Available new from Atkins Rotary (in stock, 2026-09), sold as the RIGHT mount although the factory catalogue lists 8545-39-040 as RUBBER (L); check the side on the car before ordering.

Belt-driven vane air pump feeding the air control valve, thermal reactor/port air and the catalyst; the factory test is outlet pressure above 11.5 kPa at 800 rpm with gauge set 49 2113 010B (1980 and 1985 manuals). No new 12A pump found on sale; used units only.
Runs between the water pump pulley and the air pump pulley; tension is set by swinging the pump on its strap bolt. OEM-quality replacement 1757-13-715 in stock at Atkins Rotary (2026-09).

Float switch in the oil pan, one wire (BG); it grounds that wire through its body when the float drops, lighting the 3.4 W OIL LEVEL lamp. N201-10-730 is discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix 2026-09); Atkins sells a block-off plate ARE8907 for the pan opening.

Catalogue figure 6600A-1 draws it on the front of the engine (water pump housing), which matches the No. 1 water temperature switch B-12 of the 1982 wiring diagram (LB to the emission control unit, LW to the hot start relay); check that identification on the car. 8341-18-880 is no longer available (Atkins, NLA).

specs.item: Air pump belt deflection (between air pump and water pump pulley)
specs.note: 0.47 +/- 0.04 in. The 1980 manual gives the same 12 +/- 1 mm and says pressed at 10 kg (22 lb); the 1985 manual gives 11-13 mm at 10 kg.

specs.item: Air pump belt deflection test load
specs.note: 22 lb push at mid-span; 1980 manual, repeated in the 1985 manual (S-002 p.4A-19). The 1982 table gives the deflection only.

specs.value: loosen the air pump strap bolt and mounting bolt, move the pump toward or away from the engine until the deflection is right, tighten both
specs.note: Same procedure in S-002 p.4A-19 (1985). To replace the belt, the A/C compressor belt comes off first if fitted.

specs.value: more than 11.5 kPa (1.64 psi) at 800 rpm
specs.note: 1980 gives 0.115 kg/cm2; 1985 (S-002 p.4A-18) gives 11.5 kPa. Measured at the hose to the air control valve with gauge set 49 2113 010B, engine warm. Below this, replace the pump. No 1982 figure found.

specs.value: remove air cleaner, disconnect inlet and outlet hoses, remove strap bolt and mounting bolt, slip the belt off
float up: no continuity; float down: continuity
specs.note: Ohmmeter between the lead and the sensor. 1985 manual; the 1982 wiring diagram (S-001 PDF p.16) draws the same one-wire switch to ground.

specs.value: unplug the sensor, ground the harness terminal (BG), start the engine: OIL LEVEL lamp must light
specs.note: If it does not light, check fuse, bulb and harness. 1985 manual; the BG wire colour matches the 1982 diagram.
Drawn at the sensor flange in the figure; check the count on the car.

specs.item: No. 1 water temperature switch opening temperature
specs.note: 158 +/- 11.7 F; no continuity between the two terminals above this (closed when cold). The 1980 manual gives the same (S-045 80RX7_1A p.1A:21). Applies only if this part is the No. 1 switch; check.
25-33 ft-lb, listed under Engine as 'Water temperature switch'; taken as this switch in the water pump housing; check.
Drawn under the switch in the figure; check on the car.

terminals.function: low oil level signal (switch to ground)
terminals.inside: float contact between the lead and the sensor body (engine ground); closed when the float is down
terminals.to: connector X-01, then YR to the 3.4 W OIL LEVEL warning lamp in the cluster (X-06, lamp fed from the GY meter bus) and to the warning oscillator C-10
terminals.note: from S-001 (connector C-06, single terminal); confirm on the car

terminals.function: switch output to the emission control unit
terminals.inside: one side of a bimetal contact, closed below about 70 C
terminals.to: connector X-01 to emission control unit terminal D, spliced with the No. 2 water temperature switch B-11 and heat hazard sensor B-13 LB wires
terminals.note: from S-001 (B-12, No. 1 water temp switch); the match to 8341-18-880 is from the catalogue figure; confirm on the car

terminals.function: switch input from the hot start circuit
terminals.inside: other side of the bimetal contact
terminals.to: connector X-01 to the hot start relay (Section A)
terminals.note: from S-001 (B-12); confirm on the car
